    const target = e.target;
    const anchor = target && target.closest && target.closest('a[data-anchor]');
    if (!anchor || anchor.getAttribute('target') === '_blank') {
        return false;

    if (!href) {
        return false;

    } catch (_) {
        return false;
    }
